frame.camera: 3/4 top-down, ADR-0006/0022. Prose for the reader; never parse it.
frame.sort: painter, descending world y (north draws first); sortBias breaks ties

terrain.note: row 0 = north edge. 0 = no tile (water — never baked, the shader owns it). Runs are [value, count]; sum(count) == cols * rows exactly.

ground.label: Ground
ground.x-unavailable: The ground is not tiles. It is an iso-contour of the painted height map (PaintedHeightMap + TerrainSplatSurface, ADR 0014) — an R8 texture stored in Git LFS, whose bytes are absent from a plain checkout. The map is pinned by its LFS oid under terrain.x-heightMap instead.

road.label: Road
road.x-unavailable: Roads are painted by the region builder from centrelines through RoadKitContract into two tilemaps (RoadTop/RoadSkirt). No road tilemap exists in the committed scene, and the blob-47 index is deliberately derived in one place only.

cliff.label: Cliff
cliff.x-unavailable: Cliffs are placed surfaces (CliffWallSurface components), not painted cells. They are exported as entities, where they are authored.

readFrom.rigIdentity: docs/art/rigs/** bytes, LF-normalised sha256 (source of truth)
readFrom.placements: the committed .unity — a DERIVED copy of builder C#, which cannot be run outside Unity. Pinned by sceneLastBuiltCommit and builderDrift.

entityNotes.x-unresolvedMeaning: no sidecar beside these sheets names a rig this exporter will trust — an ambiguous one names several. The kits that ship a *.contract.json resolve exactly; the rest have no committed link from sheet to rig, so nothing is pinned rather than guessed.
entityNotes.x-familyVocabulary: The format's `family` vocabulary is the editor's RigKit ids (dory, punt, lobsterboat, camper, character, pot, rock, …). These ids are the SPRITE NAME STEM instead, because a baked sheet does not record which palette family drew it. Every entity flags this with x-familyIsSpriteStem so nothing mistakes one for the other.
entityNotes.x-noCallRecord: call/opts are absent by ruling: the editor writes them out of its own live state and no renderer reads one back. The cost is that this document can never seed a round-trip INTO the editor, which needs family+dir+opts.
